title: Aureline macro-recorder session contract
description: Boundary schema for the M5 macro-recorder session frozen in docs/m5/recipe-builder-and-macro-contract.md. Every macro-recorder session a user records publishes exactly one macro_session_record. The recorder is deliberately narrow: every captured step is strictly constrained to UI or editor state drawn from the recorded_macro_surface_class vocabulary, the projected safety labels are limited to macro_safe and ui_only, ambient network / process / secret capture is forbidden mechanically, and the macro is never admissible on the managed-only channel. A stopped session mints a recorded_macro_manifest_record (recipe_manifest.schema.json); a discarded session mints none. Raw DOM, raw buffer bytes, raw shell commands, raw URLs, and raw credential material never cross this boundary; the record carries opaque ids, closed vocabulary, content-address digests, and reviewable sentences only. Adding a new recorder_state_class, recorded_macro_surface_class, replay_posture_class, or promotion_affordance_class is additive-minor and bumps macro_session_schema_version; repurposing an existing value is breaking and requires a new decision row.

macro_session_schema_version.description: Integer schema version. Bumped only on breaking payload changes; additive-optional fields do not bump it.

opaque_id.description: Opaque, stable id safe to log, safe on RPC, and safe in support bundles. Raw paths, raw URLs, raw payloads, and raw secrets never appear here.

reviewable_sentence.description: Short reviewable sentence intended for palette preview, CLI --describe output, docs pages, and support-bundle previews.

monotonic_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp produced from a monotonic clock source.

controlled_automation_label.description: Re-exported controlled-automation-label vocabulary. A macro-recorder session may only project macro_safe and ui_only; the macro_session_record enforces that subset.

recorder_state_class.description: Frozen macro-recorder lifecycle vocabulary. recording is actively capturing; paused is suspended; stopped has captured the macro; discarded mints no macro; promoted_to_recipe has been re-authored as a declarative recipe.

recorded_macro_surface_class.description: Re-exported recorded-macro surface vocabulary from recipe_manifest.schema.json. Every captured step MUST quote exactly one of these; minting a parallel surface (shell_command, network_fetch, credential_read) is non-conforming and the closed set is the schema's enforcement that recorded macros are constrained to explicit UI or editor state.

macro_replay_posture_class.description: Frozen replay-posture for a captured macro step. Every step is strictly UI or editor state; invoking a command descriptor from a macro step is non-conforming.

storage_scope_class.description: Re-exported storage-scope vocabulary, narrowed for recorded macros. organization_scope_managed_only_channel is non-conforming on a macro session; an organization-distributed recipe MUST be a declarative recipe.

redaction_class.description: Re-exported redaction class drawn from the capability lifecycle / secret broker contract.

promotion_affordance_class.description: Frozen promotion-affordance vocabulary. A captured macro is re-authored as a declarative recipe via promotion; promotion is never a silent forward.

content_address.description: Content-address of the captured UI / editor state. The macro replayer MUST refuse to drift from the captured state without an explicit reconciliation step; raw DOM / raw buffer bytes never cross this boundary.

macro_capture_step.description: One captured macro step, strictly constrained to UI or editor state.

projected_safety_labels.description: A macro-recorder session may only project macro_safe and ui_only. Any other label is non-conforming; the closed subset is the schema's enforcement that recorded macros have no ambient effect.

resulting_macro_manifest_ref.description: Opaque ref to the recorded_macro_manifest_record this session minted, or null when the session was discarded.

manifest_target_schema_ref.description: Schema the recorder mints a recorded-macro manifest against on stop. MUST be schemas/automation/recipe_manifest.schema.json.

allOf.description: A discarded session mints no macro manifest and is not promotable.
A stopped or promoted session has a non-null resulting macro manifest ref.

macro_session_record.description: Canonical macro-recorder session. Strictly constrained to UI or editor state; ambient network / process / secret capture is forbidden mechanically by the closed surface and label vocabularies.
